title: Rumour: Robert Pattinson's possible James Bond deal would be shorter and better paid than his rivals'
summary: Puck reports on the terms agreed with the actors in contention. No casting has been announced.
body:
This is an unconfirmed report. Robert Pattinson has agreed terms to play James Bond that would commit him to three films, compared with four for the other actors in contention, according to Matthew Belloni of the entertainment newsletter Puck. Amazon MGM Studios has not announced its new Bond, and Pattinson has not commented.

Puck reports that Josh O'Connor and Jack Lowden were asked to commit to four films if chosen, and that Pattinson's deal also carries considerably more money.

What it means

Deals like these are agreed in advance with actors who are being considered, so that terms are settled if they are picked. They do not mean Pattinson has been cast.

Reports suggest an announcement could come before the end of the year. We will update this story if the casting is confirmed.

Sources: Puck, as reported by Screen Rant and The A.V. Club.
